newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Reliance jumps 3.0 pct on NSE.
newsitem.headline: India's Reliance jumps 3.0 pct on NSE.

text.p: Shares of top private firm Reliance Industries jumped 9.25 rupees, or three percent, to 309.25 on the National bourse on Wednesday as the share entered a no-delivery period.
A no-delivery period allows speculators to trade the stock without actual purchase or delivery for one month.
Traders said speculators were also active in the stock after it announced improved results for the financial year ended March 31, 1997.
Reliance said on Tuesday its 1996/97 net climbed to 13.23 billion rupees, from 13.05 billion a year-earlier.
Reliance shares were trading 1.50 rupees higher at 309.25 on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
